title: Drawn instruments (our own)
description: Two original instruments as control points, no audio: a bass guitar stand-in (single cycle, per-register shapes) and a vowel-morphing choir pad (three keyframes). Wavetables are built in the page when a program names wt_drawn_bass or wt_drawn_choir. CC0-1.0.

ingredients.title: Drawn bass and choir pad
ingredients.description: control points and parameters; wavetables built in memory on first use
